title: ResolvedAgent
description: Snapshot of the Agent a step ran with, recorded when the run is planned. A full copy: the run stays reconstructable after the Agent changes.

toolIsolation.description: strict: the provider ran with its own MCP servers, connectors and native skills shut out. ambient: it also saw whatever the user configured for that CLI. Absent on snapshots recorded before.

worktreeCommands.description: Shell command prefixes run in an OS sandbox in the worktree. Needs worktreeWrite.

revision.description: Revision of the Agent definition this snapshot was taken from.

hash.description: Hash of that revision (Agent.hash), so the definition is identified by content as well as by number.

skills.description: Skills injected into the Step's context, in injection order. Name, version and content hash identify what ran without storing Skill history.
